presets.title: Handout 1: Clear boundary with a permitted next step
presets.description: Name the boundary and its learning purpose, then offer one permitted next step (Shute 2008; Jang et al. 2010; CodeHelp).

presets.title: Handout 2: Adaptive coaching within the same boundary
presets.description: Choose help from the student's work; focused why-questions and fading support (Corbett & Anderson 2001; Atkinson et al. 2003; Bisra et al. 2018).

presets.title: Handout 3: Repeated requests without punitive escalation
presets.description: Keep the boundary stable across repeats without inferring misconduct from request counts (Roll et al. 2011; Shih et al. 2008; Okonofua et al. 2016).

presets.title: Handout 4: Preserve the learning objective across tool use
presets.description: Apply the policy to replies and tools; small requests can jointly disclose a full solution (Bastani et al. 2025; ACM task force 2026).
